_comment: client_id is NOT secret (it's the public half of a Discord OAuth2 app, safe to publish) but it must be a REAL Discord Application's client ID for the invite link to work. This placeholder must be replaced by the server owner after they register the bot in the Discord Developer Portal - see discord-release-bot/README.md for the exact steps. permissions must stay in sync with discord-release-bot/bot/config.py's Config.invite_url (View Channels + Send Messages + Embed Links + Read Message History = 84992) - if that changes, change it here too.
